initial_impression_without_labels: A person in a dim public office is caught between a luminous brass instrument and a looming black human-shaped presence that holds her artificial wrist.

tests.evidence: The oval face, brown eyes, short dark bob and wispy fringe visibly correspond to the supplied appearance reference; this is no identity claim.

A black ribbon exits the platen slot and reaches the star cabinet, but no continuous palm-to-slot-to-upright-shadow route can be followed. The large dark figure stands behind the counter instead of visibly emerging from the slot.
The black figure turns its face back toward the woman and grips a wrist, but it grips her raised wrist rather than the wrist of the hand resting on the platen.
The same woman has a warm living face and two visibly connected jointed porcelain hands with transparent wrist tubes containing dark/gold fibers.

A bright geometric star and rings are enclosed in a brass cabinet. A vertical luminous line reaches the cabinet base, but the required luminous filament connecting that star to the black ribbon at the platen is not fully visible.
One porcelain palm rests on the platen. The black grip is on the other raised wrist, whose hand is held above contact; intended same-arm contact is lost.
Face, both wrists, dark figure and apparatus are visible together, but the critical continuity and exact contact remain incorrect/unsupported.
The image reads as an uncanny municipal transaction with a sympathetic close face, tactile brass and posthuman hands. The independent dark body is a persuasive source of dread.
